title: [DTensor] gaps in uneven strided shard
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

for full tensor [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] over _StridedShard(0, split=2),  mesh (2,), we should have following local tensor 
* rank0: [0, 1, 3, 4]
* rank1: [2, pad]

right now the result is wrong (see following repro)
* rank0: [0, 1, 3]
* rank2: [2, 4]

the wrong result is because of these lines https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/c8d790b56d7bbb4ee266976944ab920f2d513b40/torch/distributed/tensor/placement_types.py#L596-L601

the recommend approach is (5, ) -> unflatten -> (2, 3, ) -> S(1) -> flatten
```
0, 1  | 2
3, 4  | pad
```

I follow up to improve https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/163843
```
@with_comms
def test_strided_shard_bug(self):
    assert self.world_size == 2
    device_mesh = init_device_mesh(self.device_type, (2, ))
    global_tensor = torch.Tensor([0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
    dtensor = distribute_tensor(global_tensor, device_mesh, (Replicate(), )).redistribute(device_mesh, (_StridedShard(0, split_factor=2),))
    import time
    time.sleep(torch.distributed.get_rank())
    print(f"{torch.distributed.get_rank()=} {dtensor._local_tensor=}")
```

```
torch.distributed.get_rank()=0 dtensor._local_tensor=tensor([0., 1., 3.], device='cuda:0')
torch.distributed.get_rank()=1 dtensor._local_tensor=tensor([2., 4.], device='cuda:1')
```

this function is called during the process of converting to [Replicate(), Replicate()],
